test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different.

Select the one that is different.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

**Logic:** First letter + 2 = Second letter; Second letter + 4 = Third letter; Third letter + 2 = Fourth letter 

 
• DFJL → D + 2 = F; F + 4 = J; J + 2 = L
 
• KMOQ → **K + 2 = M; M + 2 = O; O + 2 = Q**
 
• ACGI → A + 2 = C; C + 4 = G; G + 2 = I
 
• HJNP → H + 2 = J; J + 4 = N; N + 2 = P

Hence, '**KMOQ**' is the correct answer.
